EmailTemplate.subject: Touching Base: I've got some great properties to share with you
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.HomePhone},
It's been a little while since we last spoke, so I wanted to reach out to you to see if you are ready to expand upon your current portfolio.
Our acquisitions team has knocked it out of the park the last 90 days or so, so I've gotten some really nice new properties this week. I will attach a few to this email for you to take a look.
If you haven't already taken a look at our 2 newest markets, Oklahoma City and Little Rock, then you are missing the boat! These two markets are currently kicking out some of our best properties.
**Prices are slowly going up in all five markets, as are interest rates, so your buying power is stronger today than it likely will be 6-12 months from now, so if you are ready to rock and roll and want to expand your portfolio, please use the link below to schedule a call with me asap.
**Also, non-recourse rates are down to 8.4% through Bridge Capital and they will do 20-year loans now, which is a fantastic improvement for our clients compared to years past.
You can also text me at 901-481-6842 if you are interested in jumping on one of the properties attached to this email.
Thanks,
Marq
